title: MrDoe/OpenCodeRAG
summary: OpenCodeRAG 是一个基于本地托管嵌入模型的语义代码搜索 RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) 插件，与 OpenCode 无缝集成，提供 CLI 接口以支持外部使用，通过向量索引和缓存技术提升代码搜索性能，适用于需要高效代码检索和推理的场景。
description: OpenCodeRAG is a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) plugin for semantic code search powered by locally-hosted embedding models. It features a seamless integration with OpenCode and offers a CLI interface for external usage.
